newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber down on mixed Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber down on mixed Tokyo.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were down at midday after tracking a mixed trend in Tokyo and gloom in other regional markets, traders said.

At noon, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted July RSS1 buyer at 277 Malaysian cents ($1.10) a kg, down half cent from Thursday's close. July SMR20 buyer was also priced half cent lower at 254.50.

"Sentiment is still bad...it's following the Indonesian and Thai markets where prices have come down a lot, owing to the summer holidays and the general absence of buyers," said a trader in Kuala Lumpur.
He said production was ample but offtake was rather limited in all trading centres of the region.
A check with Malaysian trading houses at noon showed the SMR 20 offered at 250 cents, SMR 10 at 252, SMR 5 at 264, SMR CV at 323, SMR L at 302, and drum latex at 219.
A Malaysian-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU and $1,700 per two-TEU containers.
